claims.statement: Tom Allen was to be presented with a champion belt at a pugilistic exhibition at the Theater Comique on 30 April 1870.
claims.excerpt: which is tc be presented to Tom Allen to-night at the pugilistic

claims.statement: The champion belt for Tom Allen was inscribed 'Presented to Thomas Allen by his St. Louis friends'.
claims.excerpt: **Presented to Thomas Allen by his St. Louisa friends.

claims.statement: Eugene Jaccard & Co. of St. Louis made Tom Allen's champion belt and McLean Porter engraved it.
claims.excerpt: manufactured by Eugene Jaccard & Co., of this city, and the engraving was done by McLean Porter
The beli cost $1,000. It will be shown in the ring near New Orleans on the 10th of May

claims.statement: Tom Allen and Mace were to meet in the ring near New Orleans on 10 May 1870.
claims.excerpt: It will be shown in the ring near New Orleans on the 10th of May, when Allen and Mace meet

fights.excerpt: It will be shown in the ring near New Orleans on the 10th of May, when Allen and Mace meet
fights.notes: Match announced only; the fight itself is reported in articles 398 and 399.

notes: The belt cost line is OCR 'beli' for belt. The inscription is printed 'St. Louisa friends'.
